name: Mashiko (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Mashiko town emblem in white: a stylised device of a ring with hooked strokes at the top and bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Mashiko, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 January 1965.

features.role: Mashiko town emblem — a stylised device of a ring with hooked strokes at the top and bottom
